question: Should OpenClaw bundle and support this agent-facing 1Password credential broker, or require it to ship as an external plugin?
rationale: The feature deliberately gives agents governed access to live credentials and expands the bundled security and support boundary, which cannot be settled by tests alone.

options.title: Bundle after hardening
options.body: Keep the bundled implementation after correcting the CLI selector, completing security review, and supplying redacted live proof.

options.title: Ship externally
options.body: Move the broker to an independently distributed plugin while retaining only generic approval, state, and persistence-hook seams in core.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Defer the work until the agent credential-access threat model and long-term ownership expectations are agreed.

recommendation.title: Bundle after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep the bundled implementation after correcting the CLI selector, completing security review, and supplying redacted live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this person as the feature owner, assignee, and security-area contributor most directly connected to the decision.
